name: Predictive Buffer
description: Input buffer assist: early jump clicks are held and fired on the first frame you can actually jump. Press F6 to cycle the window (10 / 5 / 2 steps / off).

safe-mode.name: Block leaderboard/stat submission
safe-mode.description: If the assist fired during a run, the completion is treated like a test-mode run so it can't be submitted as a legit record.
